context: Two managers plan an upcoming business trip itinerary
purpose: Teach: ドイツ語/ペルー/ポーランド/フィンランド/デンマーク/アフガニスタン/オーストリア/カンボジア

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 課長、海外研修の希望調査が来ましたよ。ドイツ語圏かフィンランド語圏か選べるそうです。
lines.en: Manager, the overseas training survey arrived. We can choose between the German-speaking or Finnish-speaking region apparently.
lines.style: Crisp female professional voice, slightly upbeat informational delivery, mid-pace, polite business register.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: へえ、選択肢が広いですね。デンマークやオーストリアも入っていますか。
lines.en: Oh, the options are broad. Are Denmark and Austria included as well?
lines.style: Mildly surprised middle-manager tone, curious lift at the end, relaxed polite business register.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ええ、デンマークとオーストリアもあります。あとポーランドの工場見学コースも新設されました。
lines.en: Yes, Denmark and Austria too. They also added a new Poland factory tour course.
lines.style: Reading from a screen, even cadence, informative female professional voice, slight smile.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ポーランドは前任の山田さんが絶賛していましたね。研修の頻度はどのくらいですか。
lines.en: Yamada, my predecessor, raved about Poland. How frequent is this training program?
lines.style: Reminiscing briefly, then practical follow-up question, polite business register, papers rustling.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 年に二回だそうです。私、学生時代にペルーとカンボジアを旅行したので、今回は欧州に挑戦したいです。
lines.en: Twice a year apparently. I traveled to Peru and Cambodia in my student days, so this time I want to try Europe.
lines.style: Personal reflective beat, warmer female voice, slightly nostalgic, then resolved and forward-looking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 面白い経歴ですね。私はずっと国内ばかりで、せいぜい富山支社の応援に行った程度です。
lines.en: Interesting background. I've only worked domestically — at most I went to help out the Toyama branch.
lines.style: Self-deprecating chuckle, warm honest middle-manager tone, polite but personal register.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: でも課長は語学が得意じゃないですか。ドイツ語の研修なんてぴったりだと思いますよ。
lines.en: But you're good at languages, aren't you? German training would suit you perfectly, I think.
lines.style: Encouraging colleague tone, supportive lift, friendly nudge, professional female voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 嬉しいことを言ってくれますね。じゃあ来週までに第一希望を出しましょうか。
lines.en: That's kind of you to say. Shall we both submit our first choices by next week then?
lines.style: Pleased softer tone, faint smile in voice, concluding business-polite, gentle pace.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、ニュースで見たアフガニスタン情勢が落ち着いている今のうちに、海外勤務を経験したいですね。
lines.en: Yes — while the Afghanistan situation I saw on the news is calm, I'd like to gain overseas work experience now.
lines.style: Thoughtful closing remark, slightly reflective female professional voice, even cadence, sincere.
